sentences.en: He thought he could get away with his erroneous sentence.
sentences.zh: 他认为自己可以用那个错误的句子蒙混过关。

sentences.en: He thought he could escape scott free with his erroneous sentence.
sentences.zh: 他以为可以用那个错误的句子全身而退。

sentences.en: A person can be very intelligent, yet have many erroneous beliefs.
sentences.zh: 一个人可以非常聪明，但仍然有很多错误的观点。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：erro（看作error，错误）+ neous→错误的，不正确的
